decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the enlargement of the existing basement to create a gymnasium and a TV room, and the formation of two lightwells to the front elevation, as shown on drawing numbers LBG635-01 and LBG635-02A, received 24th February 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the proposal, by reason of its design and location would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 77 Barrowgate Road, Chiswick. The basement and lightwells would preserve the character of the original house and would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties or the streetscene. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The accommodation shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the single family house at 77 Barrowgate Road and shall not be used as a separate unit of living accommodation. The rooms proposed will at no time be converted to habitable rooms.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8am  to 6pm  on Mondays to Friday and 9.30am to 12.30pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Enlargement of existing basement to create a gymnasium and a TV room and formation of a lightwells to the front elevation to existing house
